texts.orig: The FWC system is designed to collect food waste from attached macerator stations using vacuum generated by the integrated pump and transfer the macerated slurry to the food waste dewatering press  for  separation  of  the  solids  from  the  liquid  or  to  the  holding  tank  for  later  processing  or discharge overboard.
texts.text: The FWC system is designed to collect food waste from attached macerator stations using vacuum generated by the integrated pump and transfer the macerated slurry to the food waste dewatering press  for  separation  of  the  solids  from  the  liquid  or  to  the  holding  tank  for  later  processing  or discharge overboard.

texts.label: text
texts.orig: When a macerator station lid is closed and the start button is pressed, the control system of the FWC12 opens the appropriate valves based on the selected mode and then starts the vacuum pump. When vacuum builds up in the piping system to the required level the macerator will start and the transport water solenoid will open, after a few seconds the macerator discharge valve will open and the macerated food waste will be drawn through the pipe work by vacuum until it reaches the pump.
texts.text: When a macerator station lid is closed and the start button is pressed, the control system of the FWC12 opens the appropriate valves based on the selected mode and then starts the vacuum pump. When vacuum builds up in the piping system to the required level the macerator will start and the transport water solenoid will open, after a few seconds the macerator discharge valve will open and the macerated food waste will be drawn through the pipe work by vacuum until it reaches the pump.

texts.label: text
texts.orig: Normal operation will see the food waste sent to the dewatering press immediately with the food waste tank remaining empty during normal operation, this prevents the anaerobic breakdown of any organic material sitting in the tank and the production of associated smells.
texts.text: Normal operation will see the food waste sent to the dewatering press immediately with the food waste tank remaining empty during normal operation, this prevents the anaerobic breakdown of any organic material sitting in the tank and the production of associated smells.

texts.label: text
texts.orig: The food waste press separates the solids and the liquids at 150 microns, the liquid is transferred via pump to the ships grease trap. The solids fall by gravity into an endless bag that seals in all smells whilst the unit is in operation. The bag is monitored by a sensor that measures how full the bag is stopping the system and sending a common alarm when the bag requires changing.

texts.orig: 20. In Service Package 2 a disassembly screw (P31) for the carrier (P2) is included. Use this screw on top of the carrier and screw it down. texts.orig: 21. When changing the motor (P1), make sure that the new motor has the same classification and quality  as  the  original. texts.orig: 1. Clean all components carefully. Wipe the surface of the motor (P1) upper flange and its shaft. Make sure that there is no dust or grease residue.

texts.label: list_item
texts.orig: 2. Make sure  that  the  motor  shaft  key  (P30)  is  in  the  correct  position.  Apply  a  thin  layer  of manufacturer specified special grease (P26) on the motor shaft.
texts.text: Make sure  that  the  motor  shaft  key  (P30)  is  in  the  correct  position.  Apply  a  thin  layer  of manufacturer specified special grease (P26) on the motor shaft.

texts.label: list_item
texts.orig: 3. Wipe the carrier (P2) clean on the inside and outside.
texts.text: Wipe the carrier (P2) clean on the inside and outside.

texts.label: list_item
texts.orig: 4. Mark onto the motor shaft the depth of the hole in the carrier (P2). From the top of the motor shaft, this measure is 38 mm for models 510, 515, and 48 mm for model 520, and 58 mm for models 530, 550 and 575. Carefully press the carrier (P2) onto the motor shaft all the way down to  the  mark.  If  hand  power  is  not  enough,  use  the  axle  screw  (P12)  as  a  mounting  tool.  If needed, use the rotary shredder (P10) as a handle to prevent the carrier from rotating.

texts.label: list_item
texts.orig: 5. On the end shield (P3), clean the center hole for the axle seals (P5).
texts.text: On the end shield (P3), clean the center hole for the axle seals (P5).

texts.label: list_item
texts.orig: 6. Place the washer (P4) in the end shield with the flange facing towards the motor (see the sketch below under item 8, where the parts are seen with the end shield placed upside down as on the photo to the left).
texts.text: Place the washer (P4) in the end shield with the flange facing towards the motor (see the sketch below under item 8, where the parts are seen with the end shield placed upside down as on the photo to the left).

texts.label: list_item
texts.orig: 7. Grease the sealing face of this center hole in the end-shield (P3) with special grease (P26).
texts.text: Grease the sealing face of this center hole in the end-shield (P3) with special grease (P26).

texts.label: list_item
texts.orig: 8. To avoid damaging the seals (P5, 2pcs), press each seal one at the time into position in the end shield using a tool (for example a shaft end or other round bar, see below photo) that has the same outer diameter as these seals. The seals shall be placed with the opening and stainless spring upwards towards the washer (P4) according to the below sketch.

texts.label: list_item
texts.orig: 9. The  seals  are  fixated  by  fitting  the  locking  ring  (P6)  into  the  groove  in  the  end  shield  (P3) according to the above sketch under item 8. Tap on this ring to ensure that it is seated properly in the groove in the end shield.

texts.orig: 10. With a clean and soft putty knife fill the grooves along the sealing lips in the axle seals (P5) with special grease (P26). Be sure no dirt or particles happen to fall into this greasing.
texts.text: With a clean and soft putty knife fill the grooves along the sealing lips in the axle seals (P5) with special grease (P26). Be sure no dirt or particles happen to fall into this greasing.

texts.label: list_item

texts.text: With a clean soft cloth lubricate a thin layer of special grease (P26) on the carrier (P2) sealing surface for the axle seals (P5).

texts.orig: 12. With reference to section 9.4, item 13 above, refit the end shield (P3) so that its outlet ends up 180° offset from the motor (P1) terminal box for cable connection. Take great care so that the lips on the axle seals (P5, 2pcs) not are damaged. For disposer models 510, 515 and 520 secure the end shield with tightening torque 47 Nm on the four screws (P7), and for models 530, 550 and 575 secure the end shield with tightening torque 81 Nm on the four screws (P7).

texts.label: list_item
texts.orig: 13. Grease the sealing lip of the V-ring seal (P8) and its seal washer (P4) using special grease (P26). Fit the V-ring seal over the carrier (P2) with its seal lip against the seal washer (P4).
texts.text: Grease the sealing lip of the V-ring seal (P8) and its seal washer (P4) using special grease (P26). Fit the V-ring seal over the carrier (P2) with its seal lip against the seal washer (P4).

texts.label: list_item
texts.orig: 14. Insert a small click of special grease (P26) into the keyway of the carrier (P2) and push on the key (P9).
texts.text: Insert a small click of special grease (P26) into the keyway of the carrier (P2) and push on the key (P9).

texts.label: list_item
texts.orig: 15. Wipe clean the axle hole in the rotary shredder (P10). Also make sure that the mating surfaces on the end shield (P3) and the stationary shredder (P13) are clean.
texts.text: Wipe clean the axle hole in the rotary shredder (P10). Also make sure that the mating surfaces on the end shield (P3) and the stationary shredder (P13) are clean.

texts.label: list_item
texts.orig: 16. Carefully fit the rotary shredder (P10) on the carrier (P2).
texts.text: Carefully fit the rotary shredder (P10) on the carrier (P2).

texts.label: list_item
texts.orig: 17. Wipe the carrier (P2) clean from excess grease.
texts.text: Wipe the carrier (P2) clean from excess grease.

texts.label: list_item

texts.orig: 19. Fit  the  axle  washer  (P11)  on  the  rotary  shredder.  Apply  rubber  sealing  compound  around  the underside of the entire head of the axle screw (P12) and mount this screw. Make sure that sealing compound is squeezed out around the entire circumference of the axle washer, and also around the entire head of the axle screw. texts.orig: 20. Apply a thin uninterrupted string of rubber sealing compound (P27) in the seat of the end shield (P3) in which the stationary shredder (P13) should be pressed down. See below photo.
texts.text: Apply a thin uninterrupted string of rubber sealing compound (P27) in the seat of the end shield (P3) in which the stationary shredder (P13) should be pressed down. See below photo.

texts.label: list_item
texts.orig: 21. Carefully position the stationary shredder (P13) with its upper large tooth closest to the outlet of the end shield (P3).
texts.text: Carefully position the stationary shredder (P13) with its upper large tooth closest to the outlet of the end shield (P3).

texts.label: list_item
texts.orig: 22. Tap around the top of the stationary shredder (P13) with a plastic hammer to fix it in the end shield (P3), and make sure that the stationary shredder is all the way down in the seat of the end shield.
texts.text: Tap around the top of the stationary shredder (P13) with a plastic hammer to fix it in the end shield (P3), and make sure that the stationary shredder is all the way down in the seat of the end shield.

texts.label: list_item
texts.orig: 23. Secure the stationary shredder (P13) to the end shield (P3) by hammering 6 punch marks on the end shield with even distances around the joint between these two articles. See below photo.
texts.text: Secure the stationary shredder (P13) to the end shield (P3) by hammering 6 punch marks on the end shield with even distances around the joint between these two articles. See below photo.

texts.label: list_item
texts.orig: 24. Fit a new rubber seal (P14) on the top of the stationary shredder (P13). Make sure that it is centered.
texts.text: Fit a new rubber seal (P14) on the top of the stationary shredder (P13). Make sure that it is centered.

texts.text: Reconnect and seal the water trap with sewer pipe to the outlet on the disposer end shield (P3).

texts.text: Reconnect the disposer motor (P1) connection cable to the start & stop control unit according to the electrical connection diagram supplied with the machine from Disperator.

texts.orig: 40. Reconnect electrical supply using the main electrical safety breaker on the wall/bulkhead.
texts.text: Reconnect electrical supply using the main electrical safety breaker on the wall/bulkhead.

texts.orig: 41. Reconnect the flushing water supply to the disposer by open the valve in the supply line.
texts.text: Reconnect the flushing water supply to the disposer by open the valve in the supply line.

texts.orig: The press separates the solids from wastewater by means of a 150 micron screen and a rotating screw. The screened liquid falls by  gravity  to  the intermediate  tank  and  the solids  fall  into  the wheelie bin, via the solids discharge chute, into an endless plastic bag.
texts.text: The press separates the solids from wastewater by means of a 150 micron screen and a rotating screw. The screened liquid falls by  gravity  to  the intermediate  tank  and  the solids  fall  into  the wheelie bin, via the solids discharge chute, into an endless plastic bag.

texts.label: text
texts.orig: The press has been designed specifically for screening solids from wastewater and sludge streams. The inlet wastewater should be such that it freely flows into the press without being pressurized.
texts.text: The press has been designed specifically for screening solids from wastewater and sludge streams. The inlet wastewater should be such that it freely flows into the press without being pressurized.

texts.label: text
texts.orig: The principle is simple: a slow rotating screw is enclosed in a basket with a 'press zone' integrated at the end which is controlled and adjusted automatically by the air cylinder load on the conical end cap.
texts.text: The principle is simple: a slow rotating screw is enclosed in a basket with a 'press zone' integrated at the end which is controlled and adjusted automatically by the air cylinder load on the conical end cap.

texts.label: text
texts.orig: The  liquid  passes  through  the  openings  of  the  screen  basket  while  the  slowly  rotating  screw transports the retained solids to the press zone.
texts.text: The  liquid  passes  through  the  openings  of  the  screen  basket  while  the  slowly  rotating  screw transports the retained solids to the press zone.

texts.label: text
texts.orig: In the press zone the material is compressed, de-watered and finally pushed through the conically tapered end cap to remove the solids with a consistent dryness quality.
texts.text: In the press zone the material is compressed, de-watered and finally pushed through the conically tapered end cap to remove the solids with a consistent dryness quality.

texts.label: text
texts.orig: The solid content is a function of the input material, the installed basket screen size, and the press zone cone pre-load (which is adjusted using a precision air pressure regulating valve).
texts.text: The solid content is a function of the input material, the installed basket screen size, and the press zone cone pre-load (which is adjusted using a precision air pressure regulating valve).

texts.label: text
texts.orig: The pressed solids drop by gravity through the solids discharge chute into the endless bag which is contained in the wheelie bin.
texts.text: The pressed solids drop by gravity through the solids discharge chute into the endless bag which is contained in the wheelie bin.
